question: Find the curved surface area of a cylinder with radius of base 7 cm and height 9.5 cm. ( Use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a cylinder with a base radius of 7 cm, the circumference is exactly 44 cm.

Curved Surface Area = Base Circumference × Height

⇒ CSA = 44 × 9.5

⇒ CSA = 418 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 418 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of cylinder (r) = 7 cm

Height of cylinder (h) = 9.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of a cylinder = 2πrh

 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 

 
 
• 
 r = 7 cm
 
 
• 
 

 h = 9.5 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 9.5

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 9.5

⇒ CSA = 44 × 9.5

⇒ CSA = 418 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 418 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cylinder

The capacity of a cylinder is the product of its base area and height: Volume = πr²h.

Related Cone Formulas

A cone with the same radius and height has exactly one-third the volume of the cylinder: Volume of Cone = (1/3)πr²h.
